Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.server

Class WorldEdits

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.server.WorldEdits
public final class WorldEdits extends Object
Vanilla world-edit mechanics for automated growth and removal: world border and spawn protection, entity obstruction, and the actual block placement/removal. The one loader-specific authority â€” the automation actor, protection callbacks, and loader completion notifications â€” is delegated to EditAuthority.

    • placeChecked

      public static boolean placeChecked(@Nullable net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player placer, net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel level, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos pos, net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState state, net.minecraft.core.Direction placedAgainst, net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.VoxelShape finalCollision)
      Places state through the loader transaction, restoring captured state and block-entity data when protection denies it. finalCollision is the completed placement's collision shape, since a block-entity stack can start empty and acquire its real shape only with its first deposit. A null placer uses the level's automation identity for both placement and its game event.

    • removeChecked

      public static boolean removeChecked(@Nullable net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer actor, net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel level, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos pos)
      Removes a stack block on behalf of actor, preserving that identity through vanilla protection, loader-native removal events, and the emitted game event. A waterlogged block leaves its water behind. A null actor uses the level's automation identity.
